ToD_A04_M12_VO_001.source_old: These islands don't appear on any of our maps... but the course matches our spy’s report.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_001.source_new: These islands don't appear on any of our maps... but the course matches our spy’s report.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_002.source_old: Something is wrong about this place… it feels… unnatural.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_002.source_new: Something is wrong about this place... it feels... unnatural.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_003.source_old: Yes… I feel it too… And these ruins, they look elven, but different from what Utok has described. Zuluhed, what do you think?
ToD_A04_M12_VO_003.source_new: Yes... I feel it too... And these ruins, they look elven, but different from what Utok has described. Zuluhed, what do you think?

ToD_A04_M12_VO_004.source_old: They are very old no doubt, and seem to be marked by very powerful magic… Perhaps this was once the beating heart of elven civilization on this world, much like Goria was to the ogres back on Draenor. As for the foul taint in the air I sense... something ancient... a power... a Dark presence.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_004.source_new: They are very old no doubt, and seem to be marked by very powerful magic… Perhaps this was once the beating heart of elven civilization on this world, much like Goria was to the ogres back on Draenor. As for the foul taint in the air I sense... something ancient... a power... a Dark presence.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_005.source_old: Is it Gul’dan? Do you see him?
ToD_A04_M12_VO_005.source_new: Is it Gul’dan? Do you see him?

ToD_A04_M12_VO_006.source_old: My vision is clouded, just as these islands are shrouded in fog. But the stench of fel is unmistakable.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_006.source_new: My vision is clouded, just as these islands are shrouded in fog. But the stench of fel is unmistakable.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_007.source_old: Then Gul'dan must be close, we must make haste!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_007.source_new: Then Gul'dan must be close, we must make haste!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_008.source_old: The traitors have more than just a strong fleet on their side. We can expect to face Ogre-Magi, Warlocks, and those new 'Death Knights' as well...
ToD_A04_M12_VO_008.source_new: The traitors have more than just a strong fleet on their side. We can expect to face Ogre-Magi, Warlocks, and those new 'Death Knights' as well...

ToD_A04_M12_VO_009.source_old: We can count on such forces as well, Utok. Gul'dan has made many enemies, and he can't outrun them any longer.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_009.source_new: We can count on such forces as well, Utok. Gul'dan has made many enemies, and he can't outrun them any longer.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_010.source_old: Warriors, we will set up a camp here and then continue the hunt. Come what may, Gul’dan will die today!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_010.source_new: Warriors, we will set up a camp here and then continue the hunt. Come what may, Gul’dan will die today!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_012.source_old: Zuluhed! Hah! So we’ve ended up on opposite sides... What will you do? Cut my throat and leave me to die?
ToD_A04_M12_VO_012.source_new: Zuluhed! Hah! So we’ve ended up on opposite sides... What will you do? Cut my throat and leave me to die?

ToD_A04_M12_VO_014.source_old: Wait brother! He may know where Gul'dan is.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_014.source_new: Wait brother! He may know where Gul'dan is.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_015.source_old: You used to be a shaman, Drak'thul. Is this dark path worth dying for?
ToD_A04_M12_VO_015.source_new: You used to be a shaman, Drak'thul. Is this dark path worth dying for?

ToD_A04_M12_VO_016.source_old: I don’t wish to die Zuluhed, but I obeyed Gul'dan because... because the weak must follow the strong.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_016.source_new: I don’t wish to die Zuluhed, but I obeyed Gul'dan because... because the weak must follow the strong.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_017.source_old: But now you are weak, and we are the strong. Tell us where Gul'dan is hiding and we will spare your life.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_017.source_new: But now you are weak, and we are the strong. Tell us where Gul'dan is hiding and we will spare your life.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_018.source_old: I fear the Shadow Council's wrath, Zuluhed. But if you destroy them, then I will tell you everything! They are channeling a terrible ritual on the nearby island... kill them, and bring me the artifact that they are using.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_018.source_new: I fear the Shadow Council's wrath, Zuluhed. But if you destroy them, then I will tell you everything! They are channeling a terrible ritual on the nearby island... kill them, and bring me the artifact that they are using.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_020.source_old: Heh. You think me a foolish orc, frail and ready to be put to the wolves? I was communicating with demons when you were in swaddling blankets.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_020.source_new: Heh. You think me a foolish orc, frail and ready to be put to the wolves? I was communicating with demons when you were in swaddling blankets.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_021.source_old: I wish to be alone, until darkness overtakes me at last.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_021.source_new: I wish to be alone, until darkness overtakes me at last.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_022.source_old: Me not that kind of orc!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_022.source_new: Me not that kind of orc!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_023.source_old: There’s the demon ridden dogs! Slaughter them in the name of the Horde!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_023.source_new: There’s the demon ridden dogs! Slaughter them in the name of the Horde!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_024.source_old: No more will I submit to Orgrim’s Hammer only rule! I’ll cleave your heart with my axe!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_024.source_new: No more will I submit to Orgrim’s Hammer only rule! I’ll cleave your heart with my axe!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_025.source_old: The traitors are dead... and here is the artifact, as promised.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_025.source_new: The traitors are dead... and here is the artifact, as promised.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_026.source_old: Thank you... Gul'dan's power is vast, these very islands were raised by him to find an ancient tomb...  the final resting place of a monstrous Dark Titan. It is this Titan’s terrible power that Gul’dan now seeks...
ToD_A04_M12_VO_026.source_new: Thank you... Gul'dan's power is vast, these very islands were raised by him to find an ancient tomb...  the final resting place of a monstrous Dark Titan. It is this Titan’s terrible power that Gul’dan now seeks...

ToD_A04_M12_VO_028.source_old: He was called... Sargeras, the Lord of an endless legion of demons. It is told that Sargeras was defeated and his tomb sunk beneath the ocean waves, many centuries ago. It was Sargeras’ demons that enabled Gul’dan to become what he is. It was Sargeras’ demons who helped empower our chieftains all those years ago. All that we are, everything that we have done, can be traced to him.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_028.source_new: He was called... Sargeras, the Lord of an endless legion of demons. It is told that Sargeras was defeated and his tomb sunk beneath the ocean waves, many centuries ago. All that we are, everything that we have done, can be traced to him.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_029.source_old: North of here is a great tower... that is the tomb I spoke of. It is there that you will find Gul'dan. It is there that you will most likely meet your end. You’ve got what you wanted, now leave me in peace... I would like to live what is left of my life in solitude.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_029.source_new: North of here is a great tower... that is the tomb I spoke of. It is there that you will find Gul'dan. It is there that you will most likely meet your end. You’ve got what you wanted, now leave me in peace... I would like to live what I have left of my life in solitude.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_030.source_old: Gul'dan is insane! His obsession with power will destroy this world as it did Draenor! Onwards warriors! We end this now!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_030.source_new: Gul'dan is insane! His obsession with power will destroy this world as it did Draenor! Onwards warriors! We end this now!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_031.source_old: Hmm... these ruins might hold some secret treasure.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_031.source_new: Hmm... these ruins might hold some secret treasure.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_032.source_old: The Door is open! At last!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_032.source_new: The Door is open! At last!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_033.source_old: Cho'gall, stay and guard the entrance. Kill anyone who tries to come after us. The rest of you, come with me!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_033.source_new: Cho'gall, stay and guard the entrance. Kill anyone who tries to come after us. The rest of you, come with me!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_035.source_old: Gul'dan! I knew that we would find him! Lok'tar, warriors!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_035.source_new: Gul'dan! I knew that we would find him! Lok'tar, warriors!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_036.source_old: Take his head in the name of the Warchief!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_036.source_new: Take his head in the name of the Warchief!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_037.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Not so fast, little Shamans... |n|cffffcc00Gall:|r You have to go through us first!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_037.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Not so fast, little Shamans... |n|cffffcc00Gall:|r You have to go through us first!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_039.source_old: These shamans have far more strength in them than someone so plump and lazy as you, ogre filth!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_039.source_new: These shamans have far more strength in them than someone so plump and lazy as you, ogre filth!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_040.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Aah, the Blackhand brats... |n|cffffcc00Gall:|r The two impotent sons of Blackhand. Aah, Maim, if only your wits could match that forehead of yours... maybe then you might have offered some challenge.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_040.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Aah, the Blackhand brats... |n|cffffcc00Gall:|r The two impotent sons of Blackhand. Aah, Maim, if only your wits could match that forehead of yours... maybe then you might have offered some challenge.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_041.source_old: |cffffcc00Gall:|r And Rend... you may have some of your father's cunning, but what use is that when even your sister could break you like a twig? No wonder the Horde believes that you two were naught but dirty toddlers when Blackhand ordered his warlocks to age you.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_042.source_old: I’ll cut you into pieces, you two-headed pile of fat!!!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_042.source_new: I’ll cut you into pieces, you two-headed pile of fat!!!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_043.source_old: Sons of Blackhand, I will aid you!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_043.source_new: Sons of Blackhand, I will aid you!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_044.source_old: |cffffcc00Gall:|r The jaws of death close in upon you.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_044.source_new: |cffffcc00Gall:|r The jaws of death close in upon you.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_046.source_old: None impede the wrath of Cho'gall!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_046.source_new: None impede the wrath of Cho'gall!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_051.source_old: Rend! Maim! The powers that Cho’gall control is beyond any of us! Kill him fast before he unleashes unspeakable horrors upon us!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_051.source_new: Rend, Maim! The powers that Cho'gall controlls is beyond any of us, kill him fast before he unleashed unspeakable horrors upon us!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_052.source_old: Steel yourself brother... we end this heretical filth now!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_052.source_new: Steel yourself brother! We end this heretical filth now!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_056.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Enough! The maddening shrieks of the dark gods shall tear your souls apart!. |cffffcc00Gall:|r Behold the might of our true masters!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_056.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Enough! The maddening shrieks of the dark gods shall tear your souls apart!. |cffffcc00Gall:|r Behold the might of our true masters!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_057.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r All shall serve!. |cffffcc00Gall:|r All shall feed the insatiable hunger of the gods!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_057.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r All shall serve!. |cffffcc00Gall:|r All shall feed the insatiable hunger of the gods!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_058.source_old: Is he dead? We need to be sure!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_058.source_new: Is he dead? We need to be sure!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_059.source_old: Agreed brother… I take one head and you take the other!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_059.source_new: Agreed brother... I take one head and you take the other!

ToD_A04_M12_VO_060.source_old: We have no time for this! Utok, return to the base and heal your wounds… keep the ships in check until we return.
ToD_A04_M12_VO_060.source_new: We have no time for this! Utok, return to the base and heal your wounds... keep the ships in check until we return.

ToD_A04_M12_VO_061.source_old: Arghhh! Damn it! I wanted that head!
ToD_A04_M12_VO_061.source_new: Arghhh! Damn it! I wanted that head!
